title: happy's: a bar site that looks like the bar
tag: Bar website, Cary, NC · Launching soon
summaryLead: A cocktail bar and event space in downtown Cary, with a site the owners can edit themselves.
story: happy's has a wall covered in smiley faces, a menu that changes, live music every Saturday and a second bar upstairs. A template site would flatten all of that. The goal was a page that feels like walking in: loud, friendly, and easy to use on a phone at the door. The palette comes off the wall: cream, tomato, cobalt and pink, with Bricolage Grotesque doing the shouting and Space Mono keeping the prices tidy. Menu, hours, events, photos and reviews all live in the CMS, so the staff update them without calling us.
goals: Carry the smiley wall's personality onto the page.
Make a long drink menu easy to browse on a phone.
Let the staff change the menu, hours and music lineup themselves.

features.title: The smiley wall
features.text: The bar's own wall is the hero, and its colors run the whole site.
features.story: Borders are a hard ink line and cards sit on an offset shadow, so everything reads like a sticker. The hero tint shifts slowly between the wall's colors.

features.title: A menu that works like a menu
features.text: Cards colored by section, with filter chips and a search box.
features.alt: happy's menu cards, colored by section
features.story: Specials, draft, shots, zero proof and snacks each get their own color, so you can find the section before you read it. Search handles the rest. Prices are edited in the CMS.

features.title: The walk up
features.text: A staircase that opens the upstairs bar's page.
features.story: The upstairs bar is the bar's best secret, so the link to it climbs a staircase. It opens in a native dialog, and it's skipped for anyone with reduced motion turned on.

features.title: Lately at happy's
features.text: A photo strip of the wall, the cocktails and the snacks.
features.story: Slightly crooked snapshots with a caption each. The photos swap from the CMS.

features.title: Saturday live music
features.text: The month's lineup, a poster and a card for booking the bar.
features.alt: happy's events section with the October lineup
features.story: The lineup is a list in the CMS, and past dates strike themselves out. Birthdays and work nights get their own card with a way to ask about a date.

features.title: Reviews
features.text: A 4.8 from 26 Google reviews, pulled forward on colored cards.
features.alt: happy's reviews section with a 4.8 rating

features.title: Hours and sign-up
features.text: Plain-text hours, the address, directions and an email list.
features.story: Hours are a simple table, with today's row marked. Directions and the phone number are one tap.

features.title: On a phone
features.text: Hero, menu and events at 390px wide.
